redeem and requestRedeem have identical instant-or-queued semantics: owner MUST equal msg.sender, shares > 0, receiver must be nonzero and not vault. If liquid USDC after pending reservations suffices, shares burn and USDC is sent; otherwise shares escrow and aggregate under receiver, return value 0. No separate user claim or user cancellation exists.

Queued redemptions require authorized fulfillment, which may be partial and can settle at request-time gross or a lower current-price value after exceptional losses. Live withdrawal fee applies when paid; original owner cannot cancel and privileged cancellation returns shares to receiver, not necessarily original owner. Documentation up-to-24-hour timing is not enforced or guaranteed.

Deposit/mint/exit have no caller min-shares/min-USDC/max-assets/deadline parameters. Oracle conversion and fee ceil/floor rounding apply; tiny positive deposit may produce zero shares. Fee calculations deduct configured fees even when recipient is zero, in which case fee funds stay in vault. Pause applies to deposits, redemptions and share movements. USDC restrictions can revert transfers; catalog does not grant legal eligibility or bypass underlying restrictions.

requiresAuth accepts the existing vault owner or authority.canCall(msg.sender,address(this),msg.sig); unauthenticated ordinary depositors cannot cancel. Catalog admission grants no such protocol authorization. whenNotPaused and share-transfer restrictions remain authoritative.

Requires nonzero receiver pending shares, clears the entire receiver aggregate, reduces totalPendingAssets by its reserved assets, and transfers vault-escrowed yoUSD shares to receiver, not necessarily original share owner or caller. This does not claim USDC or pay pending reserved assets; it removes that receiver pending redemption entitlement. No caller min-return/deadline parameter.
